{"parentUuid":"5c609683-36e1-473a-bd4a-05108b0c5ea7","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_3kz885i9ufkoks6d00ppi52u","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp18/a/src/hllengine/engine/PhysicalPlan.java","content":"package hllengine.engine;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * Physical plan derived from the logical plan.\n *\n * <p>This engine has a single execution strategy per logical node, so the\n * physical tree mirrors the logical tree one-to-one. It is kept as a separate\n * object deliberately: {@code explain} shows both trees, and costs are\n * attached here. Costs are simple cardinality-based estimates used purely to\n * make the plan tangible &mdash; they are not guarantees about runtime.\n */\npublic final class PhysicalPlan {\n\n    private final List<Map<String, Object>> operators;\n    private final double estimatedTotalCost;\n\n    private PhysicalPlan(List<Map<String, Object>> operators, double estimatedTotalCost) {\n        this.operators = operators;\n        this.estimatedTotalCost = estimatedTotalCost;\n    }\n\n    public static PhysicalPlan from(LogicalPlan logical) {\n        List<Map<String, Object>> ops = new ArrayList<>();\n        double total = 0;\n        double rows = -1; // unknown until runtime; Scan uses symbolic N\n        for (LogicalPlan.Node node : logical.nodes()) {\n            Map<String, Object> op = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            double cost;\n            switch (node) {\n                case LogicalPlan.Scan scan -> {\n                    op.put(\"operator\", \"TableScan\");\n                    op.put(\"dataset\", scan.dataset);\n                    op.put(\"estimatedRows\", \"N\");\n                    cost = 1.0;\n                }\n                case LogicalPlan.Filter f -> {\n                    op.put(\"operator\", \"Filter\");\n                    op.put(\"predicate\", f.source);\n                    op.put(\"selectivityAssumption\", 0.5);\n                    cost = 1.0;\n                }\n                case LogicalPlan.Project p -> {\n                    op.put(\"operator\", \"Project\");\n                    op.put(\"fields\", p.fields);\n                    cost = 0.2;\n                }\n                case LogicalPlan.Aggregate a -> {\n                    op.put(\"operator\", \"HashAggregate\");\n                    op.put(\"groupBy\", a.groupBy);\n                    List<Object> fnNames = new ArrayList<>();\n                    for (AggSpec s : a.aggregates) fnNames.add(s.fn() + \"(\" + s.field() + \")\");\n                    op.put(\"aggregates\", fnNames);\n                    cost = 2.0;\n                }\n                case LogicalPlan.Limit l -> {\n                    op.put(\"operator\", \"Limit\");\n                    op.put(\"limit\", l.limit);\n                    cost = 0.0;\n                }\n            }\n            total += cost;\n            ops.add(op);\n        }\n        return new PhysicalPlan(ops, total);\n    }\n\n    public Map<String, Object> describe() {\n        Map<String, Object> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        out.put(\"physicalPlan\", operators);\n        Map<String, Object> cost = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        cost.put(\"model\", \"unit weights per operator (1.0 scan/filter, 2.0 aggregate, 0.2 project)\");\n        cost.put(\"estimatedTotalCost\", estimatedTotalCost);\n        cost.put(\"note\", \"planning hint only, not a measured runtime\");\n        out.put(\"cost\", cost);\n        return out;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_93f7293b6663f9776959a26c","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1415,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":62264,"output_tokens":861,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_3kz885i9ufkoks6d00ppi52u":{"content":"package {"parentUuid":"31cd90bc-b42c-4318-85d0-a83573b9b507","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_0g3qg0kb01dzq6gmc0isix47","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp18/a/src/hllengine/server/Engine.java","content":"package hllengine.server;\n\nimport hllengine.api.ApiException;\nimport hllengine.engine.Dataset;\nimport hllengine.engine.LogicalPlan;\nimport hllengine.engine.PhysicalPlan;\nimport hllengine.engine.QueryResult;\nimport hllengine.hll.HllConfig;\nimport hllengine.hll.HllEstimate;\nimport hllengine.hll.HllSketch;\nimport hllengine.json.Json;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashSet;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\nimport java.util.Set;\n\n/**\n * The single-machine, in-memory query engine. Owns two catalogs:\n * datasets (tables) and sketches. Stateless with respect to threading;\n * intended for single-process request processing.\n *\n * <p>Every request is a JSON object {@code {\"op\": \"...\", ...}}; batches are\n * {@code {\"op\":\"batch\",\"requests\":[...]}} executed in order.\n */\npublic final class Engine {\n\n    private final Map<String, Dataset> datasets = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n    private final Map<String, k < args.length; k++) {\n                switch (args[k]) {\n                    case \"--pretty\": pretty = true; break;\n                    case \"--file\": file = requireArg(args, ++k, \"--file\"); break;\n                    case \"selftest\": mode = \"selftest\"; break;\n                    case \"experiment\": mode = \"experiment\"; break;\n                    case \"--trials\": trials = Integer.parseInt(requireArg(args, ++k, \"--trials\")); break;\n                    case \"--out-dir\": outDir = requireArg(args, ++k, \"--out-dir\"); break;\n                    case \"--help\", \"-h\":\n                        printHelp();\n                        return;\n                    default:\n                        throw new ApiException(ApiException.BAD_REQUEST, \"unknown argument \\\"\" + args[k] + \"\\\"\");\n                }\n            }\n\n            switch (mode) {\n                case \"selftest\": {\n                    boolean ok = TestRunner.runAll(System.out);\n                    System.exit(ok ? 0 : 1);\n                }\n                case \"experiment\": {\n                    hllengine.test.AccuracyExperiment exp = new hllengine.test.AccuracyExperiment();\n                    Map<String, Object> summary = exp.run(trials, Path.of(outDir));\n                    System.out.println(pretty ? Json.writePretty(summary) : Json.write(summary));\n                    return;\n                }\n                default: {\n                    String text;\n                    if (file != null) {\n                        text = Files.readString(Path.of(file), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n                    } else {\n                        text = new String(System.in.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n                    }\n                    if (text.isBlank()) {\n                        throw new ApiException(ApiException.BAD_FORMAT,\n                                \"empty input: provide a JSON request on stdin or with --file\");\n                    }\n                    Map<String, Object> request;\n                    try {\n                        request = Json.parseObject(text);\n                    } catch (JsonException je) {\n                        throw new ApiException(ApiException.BAD_FORMAT, je.getMessage());\n                    }\n                    Engine engine = new Engine();\n                    Map<String, Object> result = engine.handle(request);\n                    Map<String, Object> envelope = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                    envelope.put(\"ok\", true);\n                    envelope.put(\"hashId\", MurmurHash3.HASH_ID);\n                    envelope.put(\"result\", result);\n                    System.out.println(pretty ? Json.writePretty(envelope) : Json.write(envelope));\n                }\n            }\n        } catch (ApiException ae) {\n            emitError(ae.code(), ae.getMessage(), 2);\n        } catch (JsonException je) {\n            emitError(ApiException.BAD_FORMAT, je.getMessage(), 2);\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            Map<String, Object> err = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            err.put(\"ok\", false);\n            err.put(\"error\", Map.of(\n                    \"code\", \"INTERNAL_ERROR\",\n                    \"message\", String.valueOf(e.getMessage()),\n                    \"type\", e.getClass().getSimpleName()));\n            System.out.println(Json.write(err));\n            System.exit(3);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static String requireArg(String[] args, int idx, String flag) {\n        if (idx >= args.length) {\n            throw new ApiException(ApiException.BAD_REQUEST, flag + \" requires a value\");\n        }\n        return args[idx];\n    }\n\n    private static void emitError(String code, String message, int exitCode) {\n        Map<String, Object> envelope = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        envelope.put(\"ok\", false);\n        envelope.put(\"error\", Map.of(\"code\", code, \"message\", message));\n        System.out.println(Json.write(envelope));\n        System.exit(exitCode);\n    }\n\n    private static void printHelp() {\n        System.out.println(\"\"\"\n                hllengine - mergeable approximate deduplication (HyperLogLog)\n\n                Usage:\n                  hllengine [--pretty]                     read one JSON request from stdin\n                  hllengine --file <request.json> [--pretty]\n                  hllengine selftest                       run the built-in test suite\n                  hllengine experiment [--trials N] [--out-dir DIR]\n                                                           fixed-seed accuracy experiment\n                  hllengine --help\n\n                All responses are JSON. Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 tests failed,\n                2 bad request/format, 3 internal error.\n                \"\"\");\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_7437355ed34e672c5b214202","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":4178,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":64312,"output_tokens":1565,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_20vaf8bz9a26ith6d38ua310":{"content":"package k < args.length; k++) {\n                switch (args[k]) {\n                    case \"--pretty\": pretty = true; break;\n                    case \"--file\": file = requireArg(args, ++k, \"--file\"); break;\n                    case \"selftest\": mode = \"selftest\"; break;\n                    case \"experiment\": mode = \"experiment\"; break;\n                    case \"--trials\": trials = Integer.parseInt(requireArg(args, ++k, \"--trials\")); break;\n                    case \"--out-dir\": outDir = requireArg(args, ++k, \"--out-dir\"); break;\n                    case \"--help\", \"-h\":\n                        printHelp();\n                        return;\n                    default:\n                        throw new ApiException(ApiException.BAD_REQUEST, \"unknown argument \\\"\" + args[k] + \"\\\"\");\n                }\n            }\n\n            switch (mode) {\n                case \"selftest\": {\n                    boolean ok = TestRunner.runAll(System.out);\n                    System.exit(ok ? 0 : 1);\n                }\n                case \"experiment\": {\n                    hllengine.test.AccuracyExperiment exp = new hllengine.test.AccuracyExperiment();\n                    Map<String, Object> summary = exp.run(trials, Path.of(outDir));\n                    System.out.println(pretty ? Json.writePretty(summary) : Json.write(summary));\n                    return;\n                }\n                default: {\n                    String text;\n                    if (file != null) {\n                        text = Files.readString(Path.of(file), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n                    } else {\n                        text = new String(System.in.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n                    }\n                    if (text.isBlank()) {\n                        throw new ApiException(ApiException.BAD_FORMAT,\n                                \"empty input: provide a JSON request on stdin or with --file\");\n                    }\n                    Map<String, Object> request;\n                    try {\n                        request = Json.parseObject(text);\n                    } catch (JsonException je) {\n                        throw new ApiException(ApiException.BAD_FORMAT, je.getMessage());\n                    }\n                    Engine engine = new Engine();\n                    Map<String, Object> result = engine.handle(request);\n                    Map<String, Object> envelope = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                    envelope.put(\"ok\", true);\n                    envelope.put(\"hashId\", MurmurHash3.HASH_ID);\n                    envelope.put(\"result\", result);\n                    System.out.println(pretty ? Json.writePretty(envelope) : Json.write(envelope));\n                }\n            }\n        } catch (ApiException ae) {\n            emitError(ae.code(), ae.getMessage(), 2);\n        } catch (JsonException je) {\n            emitError(ApiException.BAD_FORMAT, je.getMessage(), 2);\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            Map<String, Object> err = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            err.put(\"ok\", false);\n            err.put(\"error\", Map.of(\n                    \"code\", \"INTERNAL_ERROR\",\n                    \"message\", String.valueOf(e.getMessage()),\n                    \"type\", e.getClass().getSimpleName()));\n            System.out.println(Json.write(err));\n            System.exit(3);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static String requireArg(String[] args, int idx, String flag) {\n        if (idx >= args.length) {\n            throw new ApiException(ApiException.BAD_REQUEST, flag + \" requires a value\");\n        }\n        return args[idx];\n    }\n\n    private static void emitError(String code, String message, int exitCode) {\n        Map<String, Object> envelope = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        envelope.put(\"ok\", false);\n        envelope.put(\"error\", Map.of(\"code\", code, \"message\", message));\n        System.out.println(Json.write(envelope));\n        System.exit(exitCode);\n    }\n\n    private static void printHelp() {\n        System.out.println(\"\"\"\n                hllengine - mergeable approximate deduplication (HyperLogLog)\n\n                Usage:\n                  hllengine [--pretty]                     read one JSON request from stdin\n                  hllengine --file <request.json> [--pretty]\n                  hllengine selftest                       run the built-in test suite\n                  hllengine experiment [--trials N] [--out-dir DIR]\n                                                           fixed-seed accuracy experiment\n                  hllengine --help\n\n                All responses are JSON. Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 tests failed,\n                2 bad request/format, 3 internal error.\n                \"\"\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":7,"oldLines":7,"newStart":7,"newLines":7,"lines":[" import hllengine.test.TestRunner;"," "," import java.io.IOException;","-import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;;","+import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;"," import java.nio.file.Files;"," import java.nio.file.Path;"," import java.util.LinkedHashMap;"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"3b1f902b-1507-442c-9eab-804e702fe34b","session_id":"63a86e1b-4508-4d7a-8d0b-404215d297a2","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp18/a","sessionId":"63a86e1b-4508-4d7a-8d0b-404215d297a2","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp18-a","slug":"zesty-drifting-star"}

Each test class registers itself with\n * {@link #register}; a failing assertion records the file/line of the calling\n * test method (via stack walking) without aborting the run.\n */\npublic final class TestRunner {\n\n    @FunctionalInterface\n    public interface TestCase {\n        void run(Assert a) throws Exception;\n    }\n\n    public interface Suite {\n        void register(Registry r);\n    }\n\n    public static final class Registry {\n        private final List<NamedTest> tests = new ArrayList<>();\n\n        public void add(String name, TestCase tc) {\n            tests.add(new NamedTest(name, tc));\n        }\n\n        public List<NamedTest> tests() {\n            return tests;\n        }\n    }\n\n    static final class NamedTest {\n        final String name;\n        final TestCase body;\n\n        NamedTest(String name, TestCase body) {\n            this.name = name;\n            this.body = body;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public static final class Assert {\n        private final List<String> failures = new ArrayList<>();\n\n        public void check(boolean cond, String message) {\n            if (!cond) failures.add(message + \" @ \" + callerLocation());\n        }\n\n        public void fail(String message) {\n            check(false, message);\n        }\n\n        public void eq(Object actual, Object expected, String what) {\n            boolean same = actual == null ? expected == null\n                    : (expected == null ? false : actual.equals(expected));\n            if (!same) {\n                failures.add(what + \": expected <\" + expected + \"> but was <\" + actual + \"> @ \"\n                        + callerLocation());\n            }\n        }\n\n        public void approx(double actual, double expected, double relTolerance, String what) {\n            double tol = Math.abs(expected) * relTolerance;\n            if (Math.abs(actual - expected) > tol) {\n                failures.add(what + \": expected ~\" + expected + \" (+-\" + (relTolerance * 100)\n                        + \"%) but was \" + actual + \" @ \" + callerLocation());\n            }\n        }\n\n        public void withinAbsolute(double actual, double expected, double absTolerance, String what) {\n            if (Math.abs(actual - expected) > absTolerance) {\n                failures.add(what + \": expected ~\" + expected + \" (+-\" + absTolerance\n                        + \") but was \" + actual + \" @ \" + callerLocation());\n            }\n        }\n\n        private List<String> drain() {\n            List<String> copy = new ArrayList<>(failures);\n            failures.clear();\n            return copy;\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static String callerLocation() {\n        for (StackTraceElement el : Thread.currentThread().getStackTrace()) {\n            String cn = el.getClassName();\n            if (cn.startsWith(\"hllengine.test.\")\n                    && !cn.equals(TestRunner.class.getName())\n                    && !cn.equals(Assert.class.getName())) {\n                return simpleName(cn) + \":\" + el.getLineNumber();\n            }\n        }\n        return \"(unknown)\";\n    }\n\n    private static String simpleName(String className) {\n        int dot = className.lastIndexOf('.');\n        return dot < 0 ? className : className.substring(dot + 1);\n    }\n\n    private static final List<Suite> SUITES = List.of(\n            new JsonTest(),\n            new HashTest(),\n            new HllSketchTest(),\n            new SerializationTest(),\n            new MergeCompatibilityTest(),\n            new QueryEngineTest(),\n            new ApiTest()\n    );\n\n    /**\n     * Runs every registered suite.\n     *\n     * @return true if all tests passed\n     */\n    public static boolean runAll(PrintStream out) {\n        Registry registry = new Registry();\n        for (Suite suite : SUITES) {\n            suite.register(registry);\n        }\n        Assert shared = new Assert();\n        int passed = 0, failed = 0;\n        List<String> allFailures = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (NamedTest t : registry.tests()) {\n            try {\n                t.body.run(shared);\n            } catch (Throwable th) {\n                shared.fail(\"threw \" + th.getClass().getSimpleName() + \": \" + th.getMessage());\n            }\n            List<String> failures = shared.drain();\n            if (failures.isEmpty()) {\n                passed++;\n                out.println(\"PASS \" + t.name);\n            } else {\n                failed++;\n                out.println(\"FAIL \" + t.name);\n                for (String f : failures) {\n                    out.println(\"       - \" + f);\n                    allFailures.add(t.name + \" :: \" + f);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        out.println();\n        out.println(\"----------------------------------------------------\");\n        out.println(\"tests: \" + (passed + failed) + \", passed: \" + passed + \", failed: \" + failed);\n        if (!allFailures.isEmpty()) {\n            out.println();\n            out.println(\"FAILURES:\");\n            for (String f : allFailures) {\n                out.println(\"  * \" + f);\n            }\n        }\n        return failed == 0;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_b3b28c2d29018499948a374b","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":805,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":69432,"output_tokens":1330,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_uuguzelj1inl50foedj3tjbp":{"content":"package Each test class registers itself with\n * {@link #register}; a failing assertion records the file/line of the calling\n * test method (via stack walking) without aborting the run.\n */\npublic final class TestRunner {\n\n    @FunctionalInterface\n    public interface TestCase {\n        void run(Assert a) throws Exception;\n    }\n\n    public interface Suite {\n        void register(Registry r);\n    }\n\n    public static final class Registry {\n        private final List<NamedTest> tests = new ArrayList<>();\n\n        public void add(String name, TestCase tc) {\n            tests.add(new NamedTest(name, tc));\n        }\n\n        public List<NamedTest> tests() {\n            return tests;\n        }\n    }\n\n    static final class NamedTest {\n        final String name;\n        final TestCase body;\n\n        NamedTest(String name, TestCase body) {\n            this.name = name;\n            this.body = body;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public static final class Assert {\n        private final List<String> failures = new ArrayList<>();\n\n        public void check(boolean cond, String message) {\n            if (!cond) failures.add(message + \" @ \" + callerLocation());\n        }\n\n        public void fail(String message) {\n            check(false, message);\n        }\n\n        public void eq(Object actual, Object expected, String what) {\n            boolean same = actual == null ? expected == null\n                    : (expected == null ? false : actual.equals(expected));\n            if (!same) {\n                failures.add(what + \": expected <\" + expected + \"> but was <\" + actual + \"> @ \"\n                        + callerLocation());\n            }\n        }\n\n        public void approx(double actual, double expected, double relTolerance, String what) {\n            double tol = Math.abs(expected) * relTolerance;\n            if (Math.abs(actual - expected) > tol) {\n                failures.add(what + \": expected ~\" + expected + \" (+-\" + (relTolerance * 100)\n                        + \"%) but was \" + actual + \" @ \" + callerLocation());\n            }\n        }\n\n        public void withinAbsolute(double actual, double expected, double absTolerance, String what) {\n            if (Math.abs(actual - expected) > absTolerance) {\n                failures.add(what + \": expected ~\" + expected + \" (+-\" + absTolerance\n                        + \") but was \" + actual + \" @ \" + callerLocation());\n            }\n        }\n\n        private List<String> drain() {\n            List<String> copy = new ArrayList<>(failures);\n            failures.clear();\n            return copy;\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static String callerLocation() {\n        for (StackTraceElement el : Thread.currentThread().getStackTrace()) {\n            String cn = el.getClassName();\n            if (cn.startsWith(\"hllengine.test.\")\n                    && !cn.equals(TestRunner.class.getName())\n                    && !cn.equals(Assert.class.getName())) {\n                return simpleName(cn) + \":\" + el.getLineNumber();\n            }\n        }\n        return \"(unknown)\";\n    }\n\n    private static String simpleName(String className) {\n        int dot = className.lastIndexOf('.');\n        return dot < 0 ? className : className.substring(dot + 1);\n    }\n\n    private static final List<Suite> SUITES = List.of(\n            new JsonTest(),\n            new HashTest(),\n            new HllSketchTest(),\n            new SerializationTest(),\n            new MergeCompatibilityTest(),\n            new QueryEngineTest(),\n            new ApiTest()\n    );\n\n    /**\n     * Runs every registered suite.\n     *\n     * @return true if all tests passed\n     */\n    public static boolean runAll(PrintStream out) {\n        Registry registry = new Registry();\n        for (Suite suite : SUITES) {\n            suite.register(registry);\n        }\n        Assert shared = new Assert();\n        int passed = 0, failed = 0;\n        List<String> allFailures = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (NamedTest t : registry.tests()) {\n            try {\n                t.body.run(shared);\n            } catch (Throwable th) {\n                shared.fail(\"threw \" + th.getClass().getSimpleName() + \": \" + th.getMessage());\n            }\n            List<String> failures = shared.drain();\n            if (failures.isEmpty()) {\n                passed++;\n                out.println(\"PASS \" + t.name);\n            } else {\n                failed++;\n                out.println(\"FAIL \" + t.name);\n                for (String f : failures) {\n                    out.println(\"       - \" + f);\n                    allFailures.add(t.name + \" :: \" + f);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        out.println();\n        out.println(\"----------------------------------------------------\");\n        out.println(\"tests: \" + (passed + failed) + \", passed: \" + passed + \", failed: \" + failed);\n        if (!allFailures.isEmpty()) {\n            out.println();\n            out.println(\"FAILURES:\");\n            for (String f : allFailures) {\n                out.println(\"  * \" + f);\n            }\n        }\n        return failed == 0;\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"0bbf0ae4-7017-4740-9f36-abfc59cd8971","session_id":"63a86e1b-4508-4d7a-8d0b-404215d297a2","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp18/a","sessionId":"63a86e1b-4508-4d7a-8d0b-404215d297a2","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp18-a","slug":"zesty-drifting-star"}

The reference prints\n * {@code 0x6384BA69} for {@code MurmurHash3_x64_128}.\n */\npublic final class HashTest implements TestRunner.Suite {\n\n    @Override\n    public void register(TestRunner.Registry r) {\n        r.add(\"hash.referenceVerificationVector0x6384BA69\", this::verificationVector);\n        r.add(\"hash.emptyStringIsAllZero\", this::emptyKey);\n        r.add(\"hash.deterministicAcrossCalls\", this::deterministic);\n        r.add(\"hash.seedChangesResult\", this::seedSensitivity);\n        r.add(\"hash.differentInputsDiffer\", this::differentInputs);\n    }\n\n    private void verificationVector(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        byte[][] digests = new byte[256][16];\n        for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) {\n            byte[] key = new byte[i];\n            for (int k = 0; k < i; k++) key[k] = (byte) k;\n            long[] h = MurmurHash3.hash128(key, 256 - i);\n            // Store the digest in the reference's native little-endian layout.\n            for (int half = 0; half < 2; half++) {\n                long v = h[half];\n                for (int b = 0; b < 8; b++) {\n                    digests[i][half * 8 + b] = (byte) (v >>> (8 * b));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        byte[] blob = new byte[256 * 16];\n        for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) {\n            System.arraycopy(digests[i], 0, blob, i * 16, 16);\n        }\n        long[] finalHash = MurmurHash3.hash128(blob, 0);\n        long h1 = finalHash[0];\n        int verification = (int) (h1 & 0xffffffffL);\n        a.eq(String.format(\"0x%08X\", verification), \"0x6384BA69\",\n                \"MurmurHash3_x64_128 reference verification constant\");\n    }\n\n    private void emptyKey(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        long[] h = MurmurHash3.hash128(new byte[0], 0);\n        a.eq(h[0], 0L, \"empty key h1\");\n        a.eq(h[1], 0L, \"empty key h2\");\n    }\n\n    private void deterministic(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        byte[] key = \"mergeable-approx-dedup\".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n        long first = MurmurHash3.hash64(key, 0);\n        for (int k = 0; k < 100; k++) {\n            a.eq(MurmurHash3.hash64(key, 0), first, \"stable hash across calls\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void seedSensitivity(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        byte[] key = \"user-123\".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n        a.check(MurmurHash3.hash64(key, 0) != MurmurHash3.hash64(key, 1),\n                \"different seeds must produce different hashes\");\n    }\n\n    private void differentInputs(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        // Type-tagging is done in ValueCoding; The reference prints\n * {@code 0x6384BA69} for {@code MurmurHash3_x64_128}.\n */\npublic final class HashTest implements TestRunner.Suite {\n\n    @Override\n    public void register(TestRunner.Registry r) {\n        r.add(\"hash.referenceVerificationVector0x6384BA69\", this::verificationVector);\n        r.add(\"hash.emptyStringIsAllZero\", this::emptyKey);\n        r.add(\"hash.deterministicAcrossCalls\", this::deterministic);\n        r.add(\"hash.seedChangesResult\", this::seedSensitivity);\n        r.add(\"hash.differentInputsDiffer\", this::differentInputs);\n    }\n\n    private void verificationVector(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        byte[][] digests = new byte[256][16];\n        for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) {\n            byte[] key = new byte[i];\n            for (int k = 0; k < i; k++) key[k] = (byte) k;\n            long[] h = MurmurHash3.hash128(key, 256 - i);\n            // Store the digest in the reference's native little-endian layout.\n            for (int half = 0; half < 2; half++) {\n                long v = h[half];\n                for (int b = 0; b < 8; b++) {\n                    digests[i][half * 8 + b] = (byte) (v >>> (8 * b));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        byte[] blob = new byte[256 * 16];\n        for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) {\n            System.arraycopy(digests[i], 0, blob, i * 16, 16);\n        }\n        long[] finalHash = MurmurHash3.hash128(blob, 0);\n        long h1 = finalHash[0];\n        int verification = (int) (h1 & 0xffffffffL);\n        a.eq(String.format(\"0x%08X\", verification), \"0x6384BA69\",\n                \"MurmurHash3_x64_128 reference verification constant\");\n    }\n\n    private void emptyKey(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        long[] h = MurmurHash3.hash128(new byte[0], 0);\n        a.eq(h[0], 0L, \"empty key h1\");\n        a.eq(h[1], 0L, \"empty key h2\");\n    }\n\n    private void deterministic(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        byte[] key = \"mergeable-approx-dedup\".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n        long first = MurmurHash3.hash64(key, 0);\n        for (int k = 0; k < 100; k++) {\n            a.eq(MurmurHash3.hash64(key, 0), first, \"stable hash across calls\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void seedSensitivity(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        byte[] key = \"user-123\".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n        a.check(MurmurHash3.hash64(key, 0) != MurmurHash3.hash64(key, 1),\n                \"different seeds must produce different hashes\");\n    }\n\n    private void differentInputs(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        // Type-tagging is done in ValueCoding; here raw distinct strings must differ.\n        long h1 = MurmurHash3.hash64(\"1\".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8), 0);\n        long h2 = MurmurHash3.hash64(\"2\".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8), 0);\n        a.check(h1 != h2, \"\\\"1\\\" vs \\\"2\\\" hashes differ\");\n        long h3 = MurmurHash3.hash64(\"12\".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8), 0);\n        long h4 = MurmurHash3.hash64(\"21\".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8), 0);\n        a.check(h3 != h4, \"\\\"12\\\" vs \\\"21\\\" hashes differ\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":40,"oldLines":11,"newStart":40,"newLines":21,"lines":["         }","         byte[] blob = new byte[256 * 16];","         for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) {","+            // The reference verification harness appends each 128-bit digest","+            // in the machine's native little-endian byte order (h1 then h2).","             System.arraycopy(digests[i], 0, blob, i * 16, 16);","         }","         long[] finalHash = MurmurHash3.hash128(blob, 0);","-        long h1 = finalHash[0];","-        int verification = (int) (h1 & 0xffffffffL);","+        // The reference reads back the first 4 bytes of the digest and","+        // interprets them as a little-endian uint32.","+        byte h1b0 = (byte) finalHash[0];","+        byte h1b1 = (byte) (finalHash[0] >>> 8);","+        byte h1b2 = (byte) (finalHash[0] >>> 16);","+        byte h1b3 = (byte) (finalHash[0] >>> 24);","+        int verification = ((h1b0 & 0xff))","+                | ((h1b1 & 0xff) << 8)","+                | ((h1b2 & 0xff) << 16)","+                | ((h1b3 & 0xff) << 24);","         a.eq(String.format(\"0x%08X\", verification), \"0x6384BA69\",","                 \"MurmurHash3_x64_128 reference verification constant\");","     }"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"6f990902-ec78-4220-9061-6d402a4fa7f8","session_id":"63a86e1b-4508-4d7a-8d0b-404215d297a2","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp18/a","sessionId":"63a86e1b-4508-4d7a-8d0b-404215d297a2","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp18-a","slug":"zesty-drifting-star"}

{"parentUuid":"8abae441-d50c-4606-8bbf-d32bc7d2989e","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_9nolgzznjyqvr1yeoq77anzm","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp18/a/src/hllengine/test/HllSketchTest.java","content":"package hllengine.test;\n\nimport hllengine.hll.HllConfig;\nimport hllengine.hll.HllEstimate;\nimport hllengine.hll.HllSketch;\nimport hllengine.hll.ValueCoding;\n\npublic final class HllSketchTest implements TestRunner.Suite {\n\n    @Override\n    public void register(TestRunner.Registry r) {\n        r.add(\"hll.emptySketchEstimatesZero\", this::emptySketch);\n        r.add(\"hll.singleDistinctValue\", this::singleValue);\n        r.add(\"hll.duplicateInsertsCountAsOne\", this::duplicates);\n        r.add(\"hll.typeTagsPreventCrossTypeCollisions\", this::typeTags);\n        r.add(\"hll.shardMergeEqualsUnionSketch\", this::shardMerge);\n        r.add(\"hll.partitionedMergeAcrossKeys\", this::partitionedMerge);\n        r.add(\"hll.estimatesAreAccurateOverSeveralScales\", this::accuracy);\n        r.add(\"hll.observedCountTracksStreamLength\", this::observedCount);\n    }\n\n    private void emptySketch(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        HllSketch s = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n        HllEstimate e = s.estimate();\n        a.eq(e.estimatedCardinality(), 0L, \"empty estimate is 0\");\n        a.eq(e.observedCount(), 0L, \"empty observed count\");\n        a.check(e.empty(), \"empty flag\");\n        a.eq(e.zeroRegisters(), 4096, \"all registers zero\");\n    }\n\n    private void singleValue(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        HllSketch s = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n        s.offerValue(\"only-one\");\n        HllEstimate e = s.estimate();\n        a.eq(e.estimatedCardinality(), 1L, \"one distinct estimates as 1\");\n        a.check(!e.empty(), \"not empty\");\n    }\n\n    private void duplicates(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        HllSketch s = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n        for (int k = 0; k < 10_000; k++) {\n            s.offerValue(\"same-value\");\n        }\n        HllEstimate e = s.estimate();\n        a.eq(e.estimatedCardinality(), 1L, \"10k identical inserts -> 1 distinct\");\n        a.eq(e.observedCount(), 10_000L, \"observed stream length is 10000\");\n\n        // Two distinct values, highly duplicated.\n        HllSketch two = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n        for (int k = 0; k < 5_000; k++) {\n            two.offerValue(\"a\");\n            two.offerValue(\"b\");\n        }\n        a.eq(two.estimate().estimatedCardinality(), 2L, \"two duplicated values -> 2 distinct\");\n    }\n\n    private void typeTags(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        // 1 (number), \"1\" (string), true (boolean) must remain three distinct values.\n        HllSketch s = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(14, 0));\n        s.offerValue(1L);\n        s.offerValue(\"1\");\n        s.offerValue(Boolean.TRUE);\n        long est = s.estimate().estimatedCardinality();\n        a.check(est >= 2 && est <= 4, \"typed encodings do not collide (got \" + est + \")\");\n\n        // Direct byte-encoding check.\n        a.check(!java.util.Arrays.equals(ValueCoding.encode(1L), ValueCoding.encode(\"1\")),\n                \"long 1 and string \\\"1\\\" encode differently\");\n        a.check(!java.util.Arrays.equals(ValueCoding.encode(1L), ValueCoding.encode(1.0)),\n                \"long 1 and double 1.0 encode differently by design\");\n    }\n\n    private void shardMerge(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        // Two shards share half their keys: |A ∪ B| = 1500, |A|=|B|=1000.\n        HllSketch shard1 = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n        HllSketch shard2 = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n        HllSketch truth = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n\n        for (long k = 0; k < 1000; k++) {\n            shard1.offerLong(k);\n            truth.offerLong(k);\n        }\n        for (long k = 500; k < 1500; k++) {\n            shard2.offerLong(k);\n            truth.offerLong(k);\n        }\n\n        HllSketch merged = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n        merged.merge(shard1);\n        merged.merge(shard2);\n\n        HllEstimate est = merged.estimate();\n        // 3-sigma at p=12 ~= 4.9%; deterministic, use a 7% test band.\n        a.approx(est.estimatedCardinality(), 1500, 0.07, \"overlapping-shard union ~1500\");\n        // Register state must equal the directly-built union.\n        for (int k = 0; k < 4096; k++) {\n            a.eq(merged.registerValue(k), truth.registerValue(k),\n                    \"merged registers match direct union at \" + k);\n        }\n        a.eq(merged.observedCount(), 2000L, \"merged observed count sums shard stream lengths\");\n    }\n\n    private void partitionedMerge(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        // 8 disjoint key ranges merged together against one single-builder sketch.\n        int shards = 8;\n        int perShard = 2_000;\n        HllSketch[] parts = new HllSketch[shards];\n        HllSketch whole = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n        for (int s = 0; s < shards; s++) {\n            parts[s] = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n            for (int k = 0; k < perShard; k++) {\n                long v = (long) s * perShard + k;\n                parts[s].offerLong(v);\n                whole.offerLong(v);\n            }\n        }\n        HllSketch merged = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n        for (HllSketch p : parts) merged.merge(p);\n        for (int k = 0; k < 4096; k++) {\n            a.eq(merged.registerValue(k), whole.registerValue(k),\n                    \"disjoint merge registers identical at \" + k);\n        }\n        a.approx(merged.estimate().estimatedCardinality(),\n                (long) shards * perShard, 0.06, \"8-way disjoint union ~16000\");\n    }\n\n    private void accuracy(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        long[] cardinalities = {100L, 1_000L, 10_000L, 100_000L, 1_000_000L};\n        for (long n : cardinalities) {\n            HllSketch s = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n            for (long k = 0; k < n; k++) s.offerLong(k);\n            long est = s.estimate().estimatedCardinality();\n            double rel = Math.abs(est - n) / (double) n;\n            // Fixed inputs: assert we are inside a generous 3.5% band (nominal sigma 1.625%).\n            a.check(rel < 0.035,\n                    \"cardinality \" + n + \" estimated \" + est + \" (rel error \"\n                            + String.format(\"%.3f%%\", rel * 100) + \") within 3.5%\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void observedCount(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        HllSketch s = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(10, 0));\n        for (int k = 0; k < 300; k++) s.offerValue(\"k\" + (k % 50));\n        HllEstimate e = s.estimate();\n        a.eq(e.observedCount(), 300L, \"observedCount counts inserts with duplication\");\n        a.approx(e.estimatedCardinality(), 50, 0.10, \"distinct is still ~50\");\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_82ecb79d6de21aec008e2be4","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1635,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":73528,"output_tokens":2248,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_9nolgzznjyqvr1yeoq77anzm":{"content":"package {"parentUuid":"20da5e80-d894-4be9-802a-7db1872c7ee4","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_0t136f6r9zyy9m6pquzsm0qs","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp18/a/src/hllengine/test/SerializationTest.java","content":"package hllengine.test;\n\nimport hllengine.api.ApiException;\nimport hllengine.hll.HllConfig;\nimport hllengine.hll.HllSketch;\n\nimport java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;\nimport java.util.Base64;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\npublic final class SerializationTest implements TestRunner.Suite {\n\n    @Override\n    public void register(TestRunner.Registry r) {\n        r.add(\"ser.emptySketchRoundTrips\", this::emptyRoundTrip);\n        r.add(\"ser.populatedSketchRoundTripsExactly\", this::populatedRoundTrip);\n        r.add(\"ser.mergedSketchSurvivesExportImport\", this::mergedRoundTrip);\n        r.add(\"ser.rejectsBadBase64\", this::badBase64);\n        r.add(\"ser.rejectsNull\", this::nullInput);\n        r.add(\"ser.rejectsWrongMagic\", this::wrongMagic);\n        r.add(\"ser.rejectsTruncatedPayload\", this::truncated);\n        r.add(\"ser.rejectsUnsupportedVersion\", this::badVersion);\n        r.add(\"ser.rejectsNonzeroFlags\", this::badFlags);\n        r.add(\"ser.rejectsOutOfRangePrecision\", this::badPrecision);\n        r.add(\"ser.rejectsUnknownHashId\", this::badHashId);\n        r.add(\"ser.rejectsCorruptChecksum\", this::badChecksum);\n        r.add(\"ser.rejectsRegisterRankAboveMax\", this::badRank);\n        r.add(\"ser.rejectsNegativeObservedCount\", this::negativeCount);\n        r.add(\"ser.envelopeConfigMismatchRejected\", this::envelopeMismatch);\n        r.add(\"ser.jsonExportIsSelfDescribing\", this::envelopeShape);\n    }\n\n    private HllSketch build(long distinct) {\n        HllSketch s = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n        for (long k = 0; k < distinct; k++) s.offerLong(k);\n        return s;\n    }\n\n    private void assertRejected(TestRunner.Assert a, byte[] bytes, String what) {\n        boolean threw = false;\n        String code = null;\n        try {\n            HllSketch.deserialize(bytes);\n        } catch (ApiException ae) {\n            threw = true;\n            code = ae.code();\n        }\n        a.check(threw, \"malformed sketch must be rejected: \" + what);\n        a.eq(code, ApiException.BAD_FORMAT, \"error code for \" + what);\n    }\n\n    private void emptyRoundTrip(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        HllSketch s = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n        HllSketch back = HllSketch.deserialize(s.serialize());\n        a.eq(back.estimate().estimatedCardinality(), 0L, \"empty sketch restored\");\n        a.eq(back.config(), s.config(), \"config restored\");\n        a.eq(back.observedCount(), 0L, \"count restored\");\n    }\n\n    private void populatedRoundTrip(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        HllSketch s = build(5_000);\n        // Duplicate some values too.\n        for (long k = 0; k < 500; k++) s.offerLong(k);\n        HllSketch back = HllSketch.deserialize(s.serialize());\n        a.eq(back.config(), s.config(), \"config preserved\");\n        a.eq(back.observedCount(), s.observedCount(), \"observedCount preserved\");\n        a.eq(back.estimate().rawEstimate(), s.estimate().rawEstimate(),\n                \"registers preserved -> identical raw estimate\");\n        a.eq(back.estimate().estimatedCardinality(), s.estimate().estimatedCardinality(),\n                \"rounded estimate identical\");\n    }\n\n    private void mergedRoundTrip(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        HllSketch merged = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(11, 7));\n        for (int part = 0; part < 3; part++) {\n            HllSketch p = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(11, 7));\n            for (long k = part * 1000L; k < (part + 1) * 1000L; k++) p.offerLong(k);\n            merged.merge(p);\n        }\n        String exported = merged.serializeBase64();\n        HllSketch back = HllSketch.deserializeBase64(exported);\n        a.eq(back.config(), merged.config(), \"p=11 seed=7 config round trip\");\n        a.eq(back.estimate().rawEstimate(), merged.estimate().rawEstimate(), \"merged registers restored\");\n        a.approx(back.estimate().estimatedCardinality(), 3000, 0.08, \"merged estimate ~3000\");\n    }\n\n    private void badBase64(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        boolean threw = false;\n        try {\n            HllSketch.deserializeBase64(\"!!!not-base64!!!\");\n        } catch (ApiException ae) {\n            threw = true;\n            a.eq(ae.code(), ApiException.BAD_FORMAT, \"bad base64 code\");\n        }\n        a.check(threw, \"invalid base64 rejected\");\n\n        threw = false;\n        try {\n            HllSketch.deserializeBase64(\"\");\n        } catch (ApiException ae) {\n            threw = true;\n        }\n        a.check(threw, \"empty base64 rejected\");\n    }\n\n    private void nullInput(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        assertRejected(a, null, \"null bytes\");\n    }\n\n    private byte[] validBytes() {\n        return build(100).serialize();\n    }\n\n    private void wrongMagic(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        byte[] b = validBytes();\n        b[0] = 'X';\n        assertRejected(a, b, \"wrong magic\");\n    }\n\n    private void truncated(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        byte[] b = validBytes();\n        assertRejected(a, java.util.Arrays.copyOf(b, b.length - 5), \"trailing truncation\");\n        assertRejected(a, java.util.Arrays.copyOf(b, 10), \"very short input\");\n        assertRejected(a, new byte[0], \"zero length\");\n    }\n\n    private void badVersion(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        byte[] b = validBytes();\n        b[4] = 99;\n        assertRejected(a, b, \"unknown version\");\n        b[4] = 2;\n        assertRejected(a, b, \"future version\");\n    }\n\n    private void badFlags(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        byte[] b = validBytes();\n        b[5] = 1;\n        assertRejected(a, b, \"flags nonzero\");\n    }\n\n    private void badPrecision(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        byte[] b = validBytes();\n        b[6] = 3;\n  @Override\n    public void register(TestRunner.Registry r) {\n        r.add(\"merge.rejectsDifferentPrecision\", this::precisionMismatch);\n        r.add(\"merge.rejectsDifferentSeed\", this::seedMismatch);\n        r.add(\"merge.acceptsIdenticalConfig\", this::identicalConfig);\n        r.add(\"merge.errorMessageNamesTheDifference\", this::messageNamesDifference);\n        r.add(\"merge.commutativeAndIdempotent\", this::mergeAlgebra);\n        r.add(\"merge.identityWithEmptySketch\", this::emptyIdentity);\n        r.add(\"config.rejectsUnsupportedHashIdAtConstruction\", this::unsupportedHash);\n        r.add(\"config.alphaAndStandardError\", this::configValues);\n    }\n\n    private void precisionMismatch(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        HllSketch x = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(10, 0));\n        HllSketch y = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n        x.offerLong(1);\n        y.offerLong(2);\n        boolean threw = false;\n        try {\n            x.merge(y);\n        } catch (ApiException ae) {\n            threw = true;\n            a.eq(ae.code(), ApiException.INCOMPATIBLE_CONFIG, \"precision mismatch code\");\n        }\n        a.check(threw, \"p=10 and p=12 must not merge\");\n        // The failed merge must leave x unchanged.\n        a.eq(x.observedCount(), 1L, \"left side untouched after rejected merge\");\n    }\n\n    private void seedMismatch(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        HllSketch x = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n        HllSketch y = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 99));\n        y.offerLong(5);\n        boolean threw = false;\n        try {\n            x.merge(y);\n        } catch (ApiException ae) {\n            threw = true;\n            a.eq(ae.code(), ApiException.INCOMPATIBLE_CONFIG, \"seed mismatch code\");\n        }\n        a.check(threw, \"different seeds must not merge\");\n    }\n\n    private void identicalConfig(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        HllSketch x = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n        HllSketch y = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n        for (long k = 0; k < 1000; k++) x.offerLong(k);\n        for (long k = 1000; k < 2000; k++) y.offerLong(k);\n        x.merge(y);\n        a.approx(x.estimate().estimatedCardinality(), 2000, 0.05, \"identical config merges ~2000\");\n    }\n\n    private void messageNamesDifference(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        HllConfig c1 = HllConfig.of(12, 0);\n        HllConfig c2 = HllConfig.of(13, 0);\n        HllConfig c3 = HllConfig.of(12, 5);\n        a.check(c1.compatibilityDifference(c2).contains(\"precision\"), \"difference names precision\");\n        a.check(c1.compatibilityDifference(c3).contains(\"seed\"), \"difference names seed\");\n        a.check(c1.compatibilityDifference(c1) == null, \"no difference for equal config\");\n    }\n\n    private void mergeAlgebra(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        HllSketch a1 = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n        HllSketch a2 = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n        HllSketch b1 = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n        HllSketch b2 = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n        for (long k = 0; k < 777; k++) {\n            a1.offerLong(k);\n            a2.offerLong(k);\n            b1.offerLong(k);\n            b2.offerLong(k);\n        }\n        a1.merge(a2); // merge with identical set: idempotent\n        b1.merge(b2);\n        for (int k = 0; k < 4096; k++) {\n            a.eq(a1.registerValue(k), b1.registerValue(k), \"idempotent merge registers at \" + k);\n        }\n        a.approx(a1.estimate().estimatedCardinality(), 777, 0.10, \"duplicate union stays ~777\");\n    }\n\n    private void emptyIdentity(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        HllSketch s = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n        for (long k = 0; k < 333; k++) s.offerLong(k);\n        double before = s.estimate().rawEstimate();\n        HllSketch empty = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n        s.merge(empty);\n        a.eq(s.estimate().rawEstimate(), before, \"merging an empty sketch changes nothing\");\n    }\n\n    private void unsupportedHash(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        boolean threw = false;\n        try {\n            new HllConfig(12, 0, \"MD5\");\n        } catch (ApiException ae) {\n            threw = true;\n            a.eq(ae.code(), ApiException.UNSUPPORTED, \"unsupported hash code\");\n        }\n        a.check(threw, \"only the frozen hashId is accepted\");\n\n        threw = false;\n        try {\n            HllConfig.of(3, 0);\n        } catch (ApiException ae) {\n            threw = true;\n            a.eq(ae.code(), ApiException.BAD_REQUEST, \"precision range code\");\n        }\n        a.check(threw, \"precision below 4 rejected\");\n    }\n\n    private void configValues(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        HllConfig c = HllConfig.of(12, 0);\n        a.eq(c.m(), 4096, \"m=2^12\");\n        a.approx(c.relativeStandardError(), 1.04 / 64.0, 1e-12, \"sigma for p=12\");\n        HllConfig d = HllConfig.defaults();\n        a.eq(d.precision(), 12, \"default precision is 12\");\n        a.eq(d.seed(), 0, \"default seed is 0\");\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_fdcaf6afd0c5a4a95e363917","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":3879,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":76600,"output_tokens":1704,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_yo3yuxwnpzyr5drmbdu5j1ea":{"content":"package HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n        for (long k = 0; k < 777; k++) {\n            a1.offerLong(k);\n            a2.offerLong(k);\n            b1.offerLong(k);\n            b2.offerLong(k);\n        }\n        a1.merge(a2); // merge with identical set: idempotent\n        b1.merge(b2);\n        for (int k = 0; k < 4096; k++) {\n            a.eq(a1.registerValue(k), b1.registerValue(k), \"idempotent merge registers at \" + k);\n        }\n        a.approx(a1.estimate().estimatedCardinality(), 777, 0.10, \"duplicate union stays ~777\");\n    }\n\n    private void emptyIdentity(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        HllSketch s = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n        for (long k = 0; k < 333; k++) s.offerLong(k);\n        double before = s.estimate().rawEstimate();\n        HllSketch empty = new HllSketch(HllConfig.of(12, 0));\n        s.merge(empty);\n        a.eq(s.estimate().rawEstimate(), before, \"merging an empty sketch changes nothing\");\n    }\n\n    private void unsupportedHash(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        boolean threw = false;\n        try {\n            new HllConfig(12, 0, \"MD5\");\n        } catch (ApiException ae) {\n            threw = true;\n            a.eq(ae.code(), ApiException.UNSUPPORTED, \"unsupported hash code\");\n        }\n        a.check(threw, \"only the frozen hashId is accepted\");\n\n        threw = false;\n        try {\n            HllConfig.of(3, 0);\n        } catch (ApiException ae) {\n            threw = true;\n            a.eq(ae.code(), ApiException.BAD_REQUEST, \"precision range code\");\n        }\n        a.check(threw, \"precision below 4 rejected\");\n    }\n\n    private void configValues(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        HllConfig c = HllConfig.of(12, 0);\n        a.eq(c.m(), 4096, \"m=2^12\");\n        a.approx(c.relativeStandardError(), 1.04 / 64.0, 1e-12, \"sigma for p=12\");\n        HllConfig d = HllConfig.defaults();\n        a.eq(d.precision(), 12, \"default precision is 12\");\n        a.eq(d.seed(), 0, \"default seed is 0\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"038f2396-23e8-45d4-a440-566f44ed1934","session_id":"63a86e1b-4508-4d7a-8d0b-404215d297a2","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp18/a","sessionId":"63a86e1b-4508-4d7a-8d0b-404215d297a2","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp18-a","slug":"zesty-drifting-star"}

{"parentUuid":"20d6761f-6324-4c18-ad3a-0c496c6c86cc","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_flef523zwj6pw1zb7i9f4rdi","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp18/a/src/hllengine/test/QueryEngineTest.java","content":"package hllengine.test;\n\nimport hllengine.api.ApiException;\nimport hllengine.engine.Dataset;\nimport hllengine.engine.LogicalPlan;\nimport hllengine.engine.QueryResult;\nimport hllengine.json.Json;\n\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\npublic final class QueryEngineTest implements TestRunner.Suite {\n\n    private Dataset sample() {\n        Dataset ds = new Dataset(\"events\", List.of(\"uid\", \"country\", \"age\"));\n        ds.appendAll(List.of(\n                Map.of(\"uid\", \"u1\", \"country\", \"CN\", \"age\", 20L),\n                Map.of(\"uid\", \"u1\", \"country\", \"CN\", \"age\", 20L),\n                Map.of(\"uid\", \"u2\", \"country\", \"CN\", \"age\", 31L),\n                Map.of(\"uid\", \"u3\", \"country\", \"US\", \"age\", 40L),\n                Map.of(\"uid\", \"u3\", \"country\", \"US\", \"age\", 40L),\n                Map.of(\"uid\", \"u4\", \"country\", \"US\", \"age\", 55L)\n        ));\n        return ds;\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public void register(TestRunner.Registry r) {\n        r.add(\"engine.scanReturnsAllRows\", this::scan);\n        r.add(\"engine.filterWithAndOrNot\", this::filters);\n        r.add(\"engine.projectReordersAndSubsets\", this::project);\n        r.add(\"engine.limitTruncates\", this::limit);\n        r.add(\"engine.globalAggregates\", this::globalAggregate);\n        r.add(\"engine.groupByWithExactAndHllDistinct\", this::groupBy);\n        r.add(\"engine.approximateColumnsAreLabelled\", this::approxLabel);\n        r.add(\"engine.explainPlanExports\", this::explain);\n        r.add(\"engine.unknownDatasetAndColumnRejected\", this::unknownRefs);\n        r.add(\"engine.malformedPlanRejected\", this::malformedPlan);\n        r.add(\"engine.numericEqualityCoercesLongDouble\", this::numericCompare);\n    }\n\n    private LogicalPlan parse(String json) {\n        return LogicalPlan.parse(Json.parseObject(json));\n    }\n\n    private void scan(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        Dataset ds = sample();\n        QueryResult r = parse(\"{\\\"dataset\\\":\\\"events\\\"}\").execute(name -> ds);\n        a.eq(r.rows().size(), 6, \"all six rows returned\");\n        a.eq(r.columns(), List.of(\"uid\", \"country\", \"age\"), \"columns preserved\");\n    }\n\n    private void filters(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        Dataset ds = sample();\n        QueryResult r = parse(\"{\\\"dataset\\\":\\\"events\\\",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"and\\\",\\\"args\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"ge\\\",\\\"field\\\":\\\"age\\\",\\\"value\\\":30},\"\n                + \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"or\\\",\\\"args\\\":[\"\n                + \"  {\\\"op\\\":\\\"eq\\\",\\\"field\\\":\\\"country\\\",\\\"value\\\":\\\"CN\\\"},\"\n                + \"  {\\\"op\\\":\\\"eq\\\",\\\"field\\\":\\\"country\\\",\\\"value\\\":\\\"US\\\"}]}]}}\")\n                .execute(name -> ds);\n        a.eq(r.rows().size(), 4, \"age>=30 matches u2,u3,u3,u4\");\n\n        QueryResult not = parse(\"{\\\"dataset\\\":\\\"events\\\",\\\"filter\\\":\"\n                + \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"not\\\",\\\"arg\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"eq\\\",\\\"field\\\":\\\"country\\\",\\\"value\\\":\\\"CN\\\"}}}\")\n                .execute(name -> ds);\n        a.eq(not.rows().size(), 3, \"not CN -> 3 US rows\");\n\n        QueryResult in = parse(\"{\\\"dataset\\\":\\\"events\\\",\\\"filter\\\":\"\n                + \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"in\\\",\\\"field\\\":\\\"age\\\",\\\"value\\\":[20,40]}}\").execute(name -> ds);\n        a.eq(in.rows().size(), 4, \"age in [20,40] -> 4 rows\");\n\n        QueryResult like = parse(\"{\\\"dataset\\\":\\\"events\\\",\\\"filter\\\":\"\n                + \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"like\\\",\\\"field\\\":\\\"uid\\\",\\\"value\\\":\\\"u1\\\"}}\").execute(name -> ds);\n        a.eq(like.rows().size(), 2, \"uid contains u1 -> 2 rows\");\n    }\n\n    private void project(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        Dataset ds = sample();\n        QueryResult r = parse(\"{\\\"dataset\\\":\\\"events\\\",\\\"project\\\":[\\\"country\\\",\\\"uid\\\"]}\")\n                .execute(name -> ds);\n        a.eq(r.columns(), List.of(\"country\", \"uid\"), \"projected column order\");\n        a.eq(r.rows().get(0).keySet(), java.util.LinkedHashSet.class.isAssignableFrom(r.rows().get(0).keySet().getClass())\n                ? r.rows().get(0).keySet() : r.rows().get(0).keySet(), \"row key order stable\");\n        a.check(!r.rows().get(0).containsKey(\"age\"), \"age projected out\");\n    }\n\n    private void limit(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        Dataset ds = sample();\n        QueryResult r = parse(\"{\\\"dataset\\\":\\\"events\\\",\\\"limit\\\":2}\").execute(name -> ds);\n        a.eq(r.rows().size(), 2, \"limit 2\");\n        a.eq(r.toMap().get(\"truncatedByLimit\"), true, \"truncated flag set\");\n    }\n\n    private void globalAggregate(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        Dataset ds = sample();\n        QueryResult r = parse(\"{\\\"dataset\\\":\\\"events\\\",\\\"aggregate\\\":{\\\"aggregates\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"fn\\\":\\\"count\\\"},\"\n                + \"{\\\"fn\\\":\\\"count_distinct\\\",\\\"field\\\":\\\"uid\\\",\\\"alias\\\":\\\"exact_uv\\\"},\"\n                + \"{\\\"fn\\\":\\\"hll_distinct\\\",\\\"field\\\":\\\"uid\\\",\\\"precision\\\":12,\\\"alias\\\":\\\"approx_uv\\\"},\"\n                + \"{\\\"fn\\\":\\\"avg\\\",\\\"field\\\":\\\"age\\\",\\\"alias\\\":\\\"avg_age\\\"},\"\n                + \"{\\\"fn\\\":\\\"sum\\\",\\\"field\\\":\\\"age\\\",\\\"alias\\\":\\\"sum_age\\\"},\"\n                + \"{\\\"fn\\\":\\\"min\\\",\\\"field\\\":\\\"age\\\",\\\"alias\\\":\\\"min_age\\\"},\"\n                + \"{\\\"fn\\\":\\\"max\\\",\\\"field\\\":\\\"age\\\",\\\"alias\\\":\\\"max_age\\\"}\"\n                + \"]}}\").execute(name -> ds);\n        Map<String, Object> row = r.rows().get(0);\n        a.eq(row.get(\"count\"), 6L, \"count(*)\");\n        a.eq(row.get(\"exact_uv\"), 4L, \"exact distinct uids = 4\");\n        a.eq(row.get(\"approx_uv\"), 4L, \"HLL distinct uids estimates 4 for tiny set\");\n        a.withinAbsolute(((Number) row.get(\"avg_age\")).doubleValue(), 34.3333, 0.01, \"avg age\");\n        a.eq(row.get(\"sum_age\"), 206.0, \"sum age\");\n        a.eq(row.get(\"min_age\"), 20L, \"min age\");\n        a.eq(row.get(\"max_age\"), 55L, \"max age\");\n    }\n\n    private void groupBy(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        Dataset ds = sample();\n        QueryResult r = parse(\"{\\\"dataset\\\":\\\"events\\\",\\\"filter\\\":\"\n                + \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"gt\\\",\\\"field\\\":\\\"age\\\",\\\"value\\\":18},\"\n                + \"\\\"aggregate\\\":{\\\"groupBy\\\":[\\\"country\\\"],\\\"aggregates\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"fn\\\":\\\"count_distinct\\\",\\\"field\\\":\\\"uid\\\",\\\"alias\\\":\\\"uv_exact\\\"},\"\n                + \"{\\\"fn\\\":\\\"hll_distinct\\\",\\\"field\\\":\\\"uid\\\",\\\"precision\\\":12,\\\"alias\\\":\\\"uv_hll\\\"}\"\n                + \"]}}\").execute(name -> ds);\n        a.eq(r.rows().size(), 2, \"two country groups\");\n        Map<String, Object> cn = byCountry(r, \"CN\");\n        Map<String, Object> us = byCountry(r, \"US\");\n        a.eq(cn.get(\"uv_exact\"), 2L, \"CN exact distinct = 2\");\n        a.eq(us.get(\"uv_exact\"), 2L, \"US exact distinct = 2\");\n        a.eq(cn.get(\"uv_hll\"), 2L, \"CN HLL estimate = 2\");\n        a.eq(us.get(\"uv_hll\"), 2L, \"US HLL estimate = 2\");\n    }\n\n    private Map<String, Object> byCountry(QueryResult r, String c) {\n        for (Map<String, Object> row : r.rows()) {\n            if (c.equals(row.get(\"country\"))) return row;\n        }\n        throw new AssertionError(\"country \" + c + \" not in result\");\n    }\n\n    private void approxLabel(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        Dataset ds = sample();\n        QueryResult r = parse(\"{\\\"dataset\\\":\\\"events\\\",\\\"aggregate\\\":{\\\"aggregates\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"fn\\\":\\\"hll_distinct\\\",\\\"field\\\":\\\"uid\\\",\\\"alias\\\":\\\"uv\\\"},\"\n                + \"{\\\"fn\\\":\\\"count_distinct\\\",\\\"field\\\":\\\"uid\\\",\\\"alias\\\":\\\"exact\\\"}]}}\")\n                .execute(name -> ds);\n        Map<String, Object> out = r.toMap();\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> approx = (Map<String, Object>) out.get(\"approximateColumns\");\n        a.check(approx.containsKey(\"uv\"), \"uv marked approximate\");\n        a.check(!approx.containsKey(\"exact\"), \"exact distinct not in approximate map\");\n        Map<String, Object> row = r.rows().get(0);\n        a.check(row.containsKey(\"uv_relativeStandardError\"), \"error sibling column present\");\n        double sigma = ((Number) row.get(\"uv_relativeStandardError\")).doubleValue();\n        a.approx(sigma, 1.04 / 64, 1e-12, \"sigma reported\");\n    }\n\n    private void explain(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        Dataset ds = sample();\n        LogicalPlan plan = parse(\"{\\\"dataset\\\":\\\"events\\\",\\\"filter\\\":\"\n                + \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"eq\\\",\\\"field\\\":\\\"country\\\",\\\"value\\\":\\\"CN\\\"},\"\n                + \"\\\"aggregate\\\":{\\\"aggregates\\\":[{\\\"fn\\\":\\\"count\\\"}]}}\");\n        Map<String, Object> explained = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();\n        explained.putAll(plan.describe());\n        explained.putAll(plan.plan().describe());\n        String json = Json.write(explained);\n        a.check(json.contains(\"Scan\") && json.contains(\"Filter\") && json.contains(\"HashAggregate\"),\n                \"explain names all operators\");\n        a.check(json.contains(\"estimatedTotalCost\"), \"physical plan carries a cost\");\n        // The plan is also executable as usual.\n        a.eq(plan.execute(name -> ds).rows().get(0).get(\"count\"), 2L, \"explained plan still runs\");\n    }\n\n    private void unknownRefs(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        boolean threw = false;\n        try {\n            parse(\"{\\\"dataset\\\":\\\"nope\\\"}\").execute(name -> {\n                throw new ApiException(ApiException.NOT_FOUND, \"dataset \\\"nope\\\" does not exist\");\n            });\n        } catch (ApiException ae) {\n            threw = true;\n            a.eq(ae.code(), ApiException.NOT_FOUND, \"missing dataset code\");\n        }\n        a.check(threw, \"unknown dataset rejected\");\n\n        Dataset ds = sample();\n        threw = false;\n        try {\n            parse(\"{\\\"dataset\\\":\\\"events\\\",\\\"project\\\":[\\\"nope\\\"]}\").execute(name -> ds);\n        } catch (ApiException ae) {\n            threw = true;\n            a.eq(ae.code(), ApiException.BAD_REQUEST, \"bad column code\");\n        }\n        a.check(threw, \"unknown projected column rejected\");\n    }\n\n    private void malformedPlan(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        String[] bad = {\n                \"{\\\"dataset\\\":\\\"events\\\",\\\"aggregate\\\":{\\\"aggregates\\\":[]}}\",\n                \"{\\\"dataset\\\":\\\"events\\\",\\\"aggregate\\\":{\\\"aggregates\\\":[{\\\"fn\\\":\\\"frobnicate\\\",\\\"field\\\":\\\"x\\\"}]}}\",\n                \"{\\\"dataset\\\":\\\"events\\\",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"eq\\\",\\\"field\\\":\\\"age\\\"}}\",\n                \"{\\\"dataset\\\":\\\"events\\\",\\\"project\\\":[1,2]}\",\n                \"{\\\"dataset\\\":\\\"events\\\",\\\"unknownThing\\\":1}\",\n                \"{\\\"dataset\\\":\\\"events\\\",\\\"aggregates\\\":[{\\\"fn\\\":\\\"count\\\"}]}\",\n                \"{\\\"dataset\\\":\\\"events\\\",\\\"limit\\\":-3}\",\n        };\n        Dataset ds = sample();\n        for (String s : bad) {\n            boolean threw = false;\n            try {\n                parse(s).execute(name -> ds);\n            } catch (ApiException ae) {\n                threw = true;\n            }\n            a.check(threw, \"malformed plan rejected: \" + s);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void numericCompare(TestRunner.Assert a) {\n        Dataset ds = new Dataset(\"t\", List.of(\"v\"));\n        ds.appendAll(List.of(Map.of(\"v\", 1L), Map.of(\"v\", 1.0), Map.of(\"v\", 2L)));\n        QueryResult r = parse(\"{\\\"dataset\\\":\\\"t\\\",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"eq\\\",\\\"field\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"value\\\":1}}\")\n                .execute(name -> ds);\n        a.eq(r.rows().size(), 2, \"1 equals both long 1 and double 1.0\");\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_71dded75bf52bb92f8650b4a","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2561,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":79672,"output_tokens":3147,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_flef523zwj6pw1zb7i9f4rdi":{"content":"package
